content: Level Three, the exotericist philosophers (particularly the latter-day peripatetics who follow Aristotle and Ibn Sīnā), hold the sensory moon cannot be split, since it sits in a celestial sphere and divine power cannot do the impossible. They read the splitting as a metaphor for the penetration of the moon's outward aspect and union with its internal aspect, the Active Intellect, which they take as the highest human perfection, that of the Seal; so the splitting is associated exclusively with the Prophet.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
